item.title: Hammond native Jean Shepherd's star keeps rising
item.description: HAMMOND — "A Christmas Story" scribe Jean Shepherd was recently named one of "Indiana's 200: The People who Shaped the Hoosier State" in a new book put out by the Indiana Historical Society.

item.title: Gary makes 'far-fetched' bid for Amazon's second headquarters
item.description: More than 100 cities across the country are reportedly vying for Amazon's second headquarters, a holy grail of economic development that would bring 50,000 high-paying corporate jobs and an estimated $5 billion in investment.
